title: TGPSC Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 130 Manager Posts
description: The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 130 Manager Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering can apply for the TGPSC Notification 2026 .
